node.statement: Kitaev application. For the arbitrary input of the root, the conclusions eta<1/4 and ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta permit application of lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit to the canonical tilde-Phi=(1/2)(I+(2Phi-I)(I-4(Phi-Phi^2))^(-1/2)), A=Im(tilde-Phi), and X star Y=tilde-Phi(XY), yielding tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi.
